body.statement: Uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal P_n\), first express all perturbation bounds through \(\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}=\inf_{(i,t)\in G\times W}\sigma_r(M^{it})\). The native and neighborhood-replaced fits satisfy \(|(gH)^{-1}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}\Delta^{\mathrm{aux}}_{it}|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4\{\sqrt n/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2+n^{-3/2}\})\), and the native estimator obeys \((gH)^{-1}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}(\widehat M_{it}-M_{it})=L+Q+R_{\mathrm{agg}}\), where \(|Q-B_2|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4/(\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\sqrt n))\), \(|R_{\mathrm{agg}}|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4\{\sqrt n/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2+n^{-3/2}\})\), \(\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^2/\sqrt n)\), \(\Delta_\gamma=O_{\mathbb P}(\sqrt{\log n/m}+\log n/m+\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}+\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}^2)\), \(|\widehat B_2-B_2|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4\sqrt n/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2+\Delta_\gamma/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}})\), and \(\sum_i\|\widehat w_{i\cdot}-w_{i\cdot}\|_2^2=o_{\mathbb P}(s^2)\). The term \(R_{\mathrm{agg}}\) contains the cubic, penalty, and native-transfer components fixed by its definition. Since \(c_{\mathrm{loc}}\psi\le\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\le\psi\), substitution changes only constants. Under \(\psi\ge n^{1/2+\eta}H^{1/4}\ell_n^8\), the corresponding remainder-to-standard-error ratios are bounded by terms of orders \(\ell_n^4\sqrt H/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\), \(\ell_n^4n\sqrt H/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2\), \(\ell_n^4\sqrt H/n\), and \(\Delta_\gamma\sqrt{nH}/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\), all \(o_{\mathbb P}(1)\).
body.justification: The theorem transports the complete linear and quadratic expansion through the native masked optimizer and proves oracle-scale negligibility under the rate-exact sufficient local-signal envelope.
body.gap: Independent-noise MNAR completion and fully observed leave-neighbor PCA do not supply the native scalar resolvent, centered ambient quadratic kernel, or feasible serial-curvature stability needed at a growing-window standard-error scale.
body.consumer: The result certifies that the estimator used for the SEC Tick Size Pilot panel can be bias-corrected and studentized without replacing its native convex fit.
body.proof_tex:
Write \(\psi_*=\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\).  All probability orders below are uniform over \(P\in\mathcal P_n\) and are conditional on the deterministic signal and mask whenever the cited result is conditional.  The replacement of \(\mathrm{def:model\mbox{-}class}\) includes \(\mathrm{ass:conditional\mbox{-}subgaussian\mbox{-}noise}\); the structured dependency corrections expose that condition in every cited concentration or truncation step.

First verify that the new envelope supplies the small parameters used by the already established native-optimizer lemmas.  By \(\mathrm{ass:penalty\mbox{-}level}\), for a constant \(C_0<\infty\),
\[
 \sqrt n\,\ell_n+\lambda\le C_0\sqrt n\,\ell_n.
\]
Consequently, \(\mathrm{ass:signal\mbox{-}window\mbox{-}envelope}\) gives, with
\(\rho_n=(\sqrt n\,\ell_n+\lambda)/\psi_*\),
\[
 \rho_n\ell_n^2
 \le \frac{C_0\sqrt n\,\ell_n^3}
 {\omega_n\sqrt n\,\ell_n^2(\ell_n+H^{1/4})}
 =\frac{C_0\ell_n}{\omega_n(\ell_n+H^{1/4})}
 \le\frac{C_0}{\omega_n}=o(1).
\tag{1}
\]
In particular, \(\rho_n=o(1)\), which is the spectral-gap and active-resolvent requirement in \(\mathrm{lem:uniform\mbox{-}native\mbox{-}active\mbox{-}resolvent}\).  The same bound is the small-subspace perturbation condition used by \(\mathrm{lem:preperiod\mbox{-}reconstruction\mbox{-}and\mbox{-}lag\mbox{-}covariance}\) and \(\mathrm{lem:fitted\mbox{-}curvature\mbox{-}and\mbox{-}weight\mbox{-}stability}\).  Moreover,
\[
 \zeta_n:=\frac{\ell_n^4n\sqrt H}{\psi_*^2}
 \le
 \frac{\sqrt H}{\omega_n^2(\ell_n+H^{1/4})^2}
 \le \omega_n^{-2}=o(1).
\tag{2}
\]
Thus the second-order aggregate and fitted-curvature requirements also hold.  Equations (1)--(2) explicitly recheck the sufficient rate conditions; they do not assert that this envelope is necessary or sharp.

Apply \(\mathrm{lem:neighborhood\mbox{-}native\mbox{-}coupling}\) to obtain
\[
 \left|\frac1{gH}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}\Delta^{\mathrm{aux}}_{it}\right|
 =O_{\mathbb P}\!\left[
 \ell_n^4\left\{\frac{\sqrt n}{\psi_*^2}+n^{-3/2}\right\}\right].
\tag{3}
\]
On the simultaneous active event supplied by \(\mathrm{lem:uniform\mbox{-}native\mbox{-}active\mbox{-}resolvent}\), \(\mathrm{lem:native\mbox{-}implicit\mbox{-}second\mbox{-}order\mbox{-}expansion}\) gives the exact linear term \(\ell_{it}\), including its negative donor--pretreatment overlap, the declared quadratic term \(q_{it}\), and the cubic, polar/regularization, and scalar-resolvent remainders.  Averaging and using \(\mathrm{def:oracle\mbox{-}score\mbox{-}variance}\) and \(\mathrm{def:quadratic\mbox{-}drift}\) identifies the first two averages as \(L\) and \(Q\).  The centered aggregation in \(\mathrm{lem:centered\mbox{-}quadratic\mbox{-}and\mbox{-}higher\mbox{-}aggregate}\), together with (3), therefore yields
\[
 \frac1{gH}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}(\widehat M_{it}-M_{it})
 =L+Q+R_{\mathrm{agg}},
\tag{4}
\]
\[
 |Q-B_2|=O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(\frac{\ell_n^4}{\psi_*\sqrt n}\right),
 \qquad
 |R_{\mathrm{agg}}|=O_{\mathbb P}\!\left[
 \ell_n^4\left\{\frac{\sqrt n}{\psi_*^2}+n^{-3/2}\right\}\right].
\tag{5}
\]
This proves the native transfer and aggregate expansion, including the stated composition of \(R_{\mathrm{agg}}\).

Next, \(\mathrm{lem:preperiod\mbox{-}reconstruction\mbox{-}and\mbox{-}lag\mbox{-}covariance}\) gives
\[
 \delta_{\mathrm{fit}}=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^2/\sqrt n),
\tag{6}
\]
and
\[
 \Delta_\gamma=O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(
 \sqrt{\frac{\log n}{m}}+\frac{\log n}{m}
 +\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}+\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}^2\right).
\tag{7}
\]
The fitted singular-space differentiation in \(\mathrm{lem:fitted\mbox{-}curvature\mbox{-}and\mbox{-}weight\mbox{-}stability}\) then gives
\[
 |\widehat B_2-B_2|=O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(
 \frac{\ell_n^4\sqrt n}{\psi_*^2}
 +\frac{\Delta_\gamma}{\psi_*}\right),
 \qquad
 \sum_{j=1}^N\|\widehat w_{j\cdot}-w_{j\cdot}\|_2^2=o_{\mathbb P}(s^2).
\tag{8}
\]
Equations (3)--(8) prove every raw conclusion of the theorem.

It remains to compare the errors to the oracle standard error.  By \(\mathrm{ass:variance\mbox{-}nondegeneracy}\), \(s^{-1}\le C\sqrt{nH}\).  Hence (5) and (8) imply
\[
 \frac{|Q-B_2|}{s}
 =O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(\frac{\ell_n^4\sqrt H}{\psi_*}\right),
\tag{9}
\]
\[
 \frac{|R_{\mathrm{agg}}|}{s}
 =O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(
 \frac{\ell_n^4n\sqrt H}{\psi_*^2}
 +\frac{\ell_n^4\sqrt H}{n}\right),
\tag{10}
\]
and
\[
 \frac{|\widehat B_2-B_2|}{s}
 =O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(
 \frac{\ell_n^4n\sqrt H}{\psi_*^2}
 +\frac{\Delta_\gamma\sqrt{nH}}{\psi_*}\right).
\tag{11}
\]
The window-length and balanced-growth assumptions imply \(H\le Cn\).  The new envelope therefore gives
\[
 \frac{\ell_n^4\sqrt H}{\psi_*}
 \le\frac{\ell_n^2\sqrt H}
 {\omega_n\sqrt n(\ell_n+H^{1/4})}
 \le\frac{C\ell_n^2}{\omega_n n^{1/4}}=o(1),
\tag{12}
\]
while the first term in (10) and (11) is \(o(1)\) by (2), and
\[
 \frac{\ell_n^4\sqrt H}{n}\le\frac{C\ell_n^4}{\sqrt n}=o(1).
\tag{13}
\]
Because \(m\ge c_Sn\), (6)--(7) yield
\[
 \Delta_\gamma=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^2/\sqrt n).
\tag{14}
\]
Thus the final term in (11) satisfies
\[
 \frac{\Delta_\gamma\sqrt{nH}}{\psi_*}
 =O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(\frac{\ell_n^2\sqrt H}{\psi_*}\right)
 \le O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(
 \frac{\sqrt H}{\omega_n\sqrt n(\ell_n+H^{1/4})}\right)
 =o_{\mathbb P}(1).
\tag{15}
\]
Equations (9)--(15) prove oracle-scale negligibility under the sharpened sufficient envelope.

Finally, \(\mathrm{ass:local\mbox{-}signal}\) gives \(\psi_*\ge c_{\mathrm{loc}}\psi\).  Since restriction to rows and columns is multiplication by contractions, singular-value monotonicity gives \(\sigma_r(M^{it})\le\sigma_r(M)=\psi\), hence \(\psi_*\le\psi\).  This proves the stated local-to-global comparison.  The older displayed condition in the target also implies the sharpened condition: if \(\psi\ge n^{1/2+\eta}H^{1/4}\ell_n^8\), then
\[
 \frac{\psi_*}{\sqrt n\,\ell_n^2(\ell_n+H^{1/4})}
 \ge
 c_{\mathrm{loc}}n^\eta\ell_n^6
 \frac{H^{1/4}}{\ell_n+H^{1/4}}
 \ge
 \frac{c_{\mathrm{loc}}n^\eta\ell_n^6}{\ell_n+1}
 \longrightarrow\infty,
\tag{16}
\]
where \(H\ge1\).  Hence the theorem's displayed older sufficient implication follows a fortiori, while (1)--(15) establish the materially weaker rate-exact sufficient envelope for the enlarged post-edit class.
